identity.findings: 约150—250年，南印度；大乘中观派开创者。与站内释迦牟尼（缘起教说的后世哲学展开，相距约五百年）、世亲（论书传统系统化）均为独立条目且关系边已标明跨时代性质。

sources.title: Nāgārjuna (SEP, Westerhoff修订)
sources.readScope: 实读全条目四节：生卒与南印、著作分组、《中论》450颂、空与自性五路破自性论证、因中四句、空非先验实在、应成派藏地官学。

sources.title: Nagarjuna (IEP)
sources.readScope: 实读全条目六节：安得罗出身、汉藏传记传统、通信系年、空与缘起中道、四句逻辑机器、不依世俗不得胜义、生死涅槃无别、第二佛陀与后世挪用。

sources.title: Madhyamaka (SEP)
sources.readScope: 实读全条目八节：二谛离言、MMK 1.1四句、归谬法、佛护清辨月称之争、自续应成藏地后起之名、汉传短期学派与寂护入藏。

checks.claim: 约150—250年南印度、生平传说纷纭（汉藏两系晚出传记）、书信系年、中观开创者地位。
checks.locator: Life节（c. 150–c. 250 CE; southern Andhra; Chinese and Tibetan biographies written centuries later mixing history and legend; correspondence with Gautamiputra Satakarni）＋sep Life and works（rarely disputed southern India）

checks.claim: 空非虚无而是无自性、缘起即空中道、二谛（不依世俗谛不得说胜义谛）、四句破斥、自性破斥使变化可能、生死涅槃不二与空亦复空（龙树不立宗）。
checks.locator: Emptiness and svabhāva节（ontological and cognitive dimensions; substance reading as target）＋Arguments各节（causation MMK 1.1 fourfold; no single master argument）＋iep（'Whatever arises dependently is as such empty…middle path'; catuskoti logic machine; 'There is not the slightest distinction…between samsara and nirvana'; no thesis even about emptiness）＋sep-madhyamaka（two truths; nirvana beyond language）

checks.claim: 提婆（弟子传承）、佛护/清辨/月称注释与应成自续之分（藏地后起命名）、汉传短期学派与藏地学统、《中论》注释传统与著作分组。
checks.locator: Buddhapālita/Bhāvaviveka/Candrakīrti各节（prasaṅga method; vitaṇḍā charge; Svātantrika/Prāsaṅgika labels by Tibetan scholastics 'not used by Indian Mādhyamikas themselves'; short-lived school in China; Śāntarakṣita to Tibet ca. 763）＋sep（Buddhapālita, Bhāvaviveka, Candrakīrti, Tsongkhapa in bibliography; influenced India a millennium, Tibet/China/Japan）＋iep（'second Buddha'）
